correctness.rationale: The truncated octahedron is [-2,2]^3 intersect sum|xi|<=3 with exactly 24 integer vertices and volume 32. All vertices have odd coordinate sum, so three-edge determinants are even. Independently enumerated all combinations of 24 signed (0,1,2) vertices with integer 3x3 determinant, obtained the complete exact table 846,552,1728,1152,1332,456,1872,360,654,408,480,72,468,48,144,24,30 at even determinants 0..32, sum 10626. The package code supplies a separate full 48-element signed-permutation orbit partition (265 orbits, max size-6+24) and the 4D permutahedron perfect-square Gram cross-check; code read/checked for algorithmic completeness, orbit partition not independently executed this turn. Squared edge-distance six-tuples separate top two congruence classes. This is exhaustively finite: no infinite theorem extrapolated.
